Gifts are modeled as convex polyhedra, so many non-cuboid gift shapes, such as prisms, work too and have their own interesting ribbon patterns. A ribbon (without twists) that is pulled tight follows a locally shortest path, a geodesic. This is a path on the surface of the gift that runs straight on faces and folds correctly over edges and loops back on itself. show_hn.title: Show HN: ModelXare – Decentralized AI Models
show_hn.story_text: I have been exploring a different future for AI where we can finally take control of our models and keep our data 100% private. I built modelXare with the goal of creating the DNS-equivalent for AI capabilities. It uses a combination of system one and system two models to dynamically route the user intent(s) to the ideal micro-model(s) that gets downloaded (and cached) locally to processes your request. This is just the first iteration of this vision. There is a lot of work that needs to be done and a lot of micro-models that can be added but imagine a world where we all can build this network of micro-models together and break the chains from the big AI labs.
